ingredients.muttonMasala: Coriander, red chilli, cumin, black pepper, fennel, cinnamon, clove, cardamom, nutmeg, mace, bay leaf

blurb.garamMasala: Ten whole spices, roasted separately and ground together to a house recipe. Warm rather than hot — the heat comes from your chilli, not from this. Stir it in at the end of cooking.
blurb.chickenMasala: A full-bodied blend for chicken curry and fry, built on coriander and chilli with whole-spice warmth. Add it with the onions and let it cook through.
blurb.muttonMasala: Deeper and darker than the chicken blend, with more pepper and fennel for slow-cooked mutton. Brown it in the oil before the meat goes in.
blurb.rasamPowder: Pepper-forward and tangy with toor dal and curry leaf, for a thin, clear rasam. A spoon to a pot, stirred into the tamarind water.
blurb.sambarPowder: Roasted dals, coriander and chilli for a thick, everyday sambar. Add it with the tamarind and let it simmer.
blurb.turmericPowder: Single-origin turmeric, cleaned and ground, nothing added. A pinch in dal, sabzi and the first tempering of almost everything.
blurb.corianderPowder: Coriander seed, cleaned, lightly roasted and ground. The base of most curries — it thickens and rounds them out.
blurb.gunturChilliPowder: Red chilli from Guntur, ground for colour and real heat. Use less than you think, and add more at the end.
blurb.papad: Urad dal papad, sun-dried. Fry for a minute or roast over a flame, and serve with rice, rasam and everything else.
blurb.fallback: Cleaned, graded and packed in 500 g pouches, sealed and batch-coded.
